facts.subject: Slam Dunk shot
facts.text: In Slam Dunk, hold Down to fill the power meter, release, then press B near the basket to shoot.

evidence.quote:
Then, when you are ready, press and hold the
down button, until the power meter (on the left side of the screen), is filled
to your liking.  Release down, and then wait until you are near the basket
before pressing B to shoot the ball.

facts.subject: Slam Dunk padding return
facts.text: In Slam Dunk, hold Down on the way back to stay safely on the padding.

evidence.quote:

meter move up just a tad, but if you did it correctly, you'll get back up on
the padding safe and sound.

facts.subject: Slam Dunk padding return
facts.text: Not holding Down enough on the way back in Slam Dunk can make you stagger or stumble off the padding, costing time.

evidence.quote:

might stagger up to the padding, or even stumble off, costing you valuable
time.

facts.subject: Energy meter

evidence.quote:

facts.subject: Energy meter
facts.text: The energy meter goes down from hard landings, sliding off poles, GUTS bag hits, falling into gaps, and running into the course.

evidence.quote:
1. Landing too hard on a jump
2. Sliding off a pole (you could do it on a rope, but the pole is far more
likely)
3. Getting hit by one of the swinging GUTS bags
4. Falling down some kind of gap
5. Running into the course (truly a funny animation)

facts.subject: Energy meter
